info.brief: Forward shading lighting for 3D games, with ambient and directional light, point and
info.description:
Forward shading lighting for 3D games, with ambient and directional light, point and
spot lights, and linear or radial fog. Add `illumination.go` to the scene as the
sunlight source, add `light_point.go` or `light_spot.go` for each light, and set
`/illumination/materials/model.material` on the meshes. The lighting data reaches the
shader as a texture, so no render script is needed. The module's functions toggle the
debug meshes and set lights and the environment by hand.

elements.name: FOG_TYPE_LINEAR
elements.brief: Fog along the camera's view direction.
elements.description: Fog along the camera's view direction.

elements.name: set_debug
elements.brief: Shows or hides the debug meshes of the sun and the light sources.
elements.description: Shows or hides the debug meshes of the sun and the light sources.

elements.name: is_debug
elements.brief: Returns whether the debug meshes show.
elements.description: Returns whether the debug meshes show.

elements.name: set_environment
elements.brief: Patches the environment with the fields given and leaves the others as they are. The
elements.description:
Patches the environment with the fields given and leaves the others as they are. The
fog fields apply only while the stored fog type, including one set in the same call,
is not `FOG_TYPE_NONE`, and `fog_color` also posts `clear_color` to `@render:`. The
bundled `illumination.go` patches each field from its own properties on its first
update and whenever that property changes, overwriting a value set here. Raises until
the bundled `illumination.go` has run its script's `init`.

elements.name: set_light
elements.brief: Adds, updates or removes a light source by hand, for lights that are not
elements.description:
Adds, updates or removes a light source by hand, for lights that are not
`light_point.go` or `light_spot.go`. `position`, `color`, `radius` and `cutoff` are
required, `specular` and `smoothness` default to `1`, and each position axis must lie
within -2048 to 2048. `undefined`, or a light whose `color.w`, `radius` or `cutoff` is
`0` or below, removes the light. `url` keys the light, so pass the same value on every
call for the same light. It receives a `debug` message carrying `is_enabled` when the
light is added or removed and on every `set_debug`. Adding or updating a light raises
until the bundled `illumination.go` has run its script's `init`.

parameters.name: light
parameters.doc: The light, or `undefined` to remove it.

parameters.name: url
parameters.doc: The light's key and the address of its `debug` messages.

properties.name: fog_type
properties.brief: The fog type. The fog fields below apply only while the fog type is not `FOG_TYPE_NONE`.
properties.description: The fog type. The fog fields below apply only while the fog type is not `FOG_TYPE_NONE`.

properties.name: ambient_color
properties.brief: The ambient light color, its `w` the ambient strength.
properties.description: The ambient light color, its `w` the ambient strength.

properties.name: sunlight_color
properties.brief: The directional light color, its `w` the sunlight brightness.
properties.description: The directional light color, its `w` the sunlight brightness.

properties.name: sunlight_direction
properties.brief: The direction the sunlight shines, normalized by upstream.
properties.description: The direction the sunlight shines, normalized by upstream.

properties.name: sunlight_specular
properties.brief: The sunlight's specular component, from `0` to `1`.
properties.description: The sunlight's specular component, from `0` to `1`.

properties.name: fog_color
properties.brief: The fog color, its `w` the fog's full strength. Also posted as `clear_color` to `@render:`.
properties.description: The fog color, its `w` the fog's full strength. Also posted as `clear_color` to `@render:`.

properties.name: fog_min
properties.brief: The distance at which the fog begins. Values below `0` are raised to `0`.
properties.description: The distance at which the fog begins. Values below `0` are raised to `0`.

properties.name: fog_max
properties.brief: The distance at which the fog reaches full strength. Values below `fog_min` are raised to it.
properties.description: The distance at which the fog reaches full strength. Values below `fog_min` are raised to it.

properties.name: position
properties.brief: The light's world position. Each axis is encoded within -2048 to 2048.
properties.description: The light's world position. Each axis is encoded within -2048 to 2048.

properties.name: color
properties.brief: The light color, multiplied with the diffuse color. Its `w` is the brightness.
properties.description: The light color, multiplied with the diffuse color. Its `w` is the brightness.

properties.name: radius
properties.brief: The light radius. Upstream rounds it up and caps it at `255`.
properties.description: The light radius. Upstream rounds it up and caps it at `255`.

properties.name: cutoff
properties.brief: The spotlight cutoff, from `0` to `1`: `0.3` is like a flashlight, `0.5` half of the
properties.description:
The spotlight cutoff, from `0` to `1`: `0.3` is like a flashlight, `0.5` half of the
sphere, and `1` no cutoff.

properties.name: direction
properties.brief: The direction a spotlight shines. Read only while `cutoff` is below `1`.
properties.description: The direction a spotlight shines. Read only while `cutoff` is below `1`.

properties.name: specular
properties.brief: The light's specular component, from `0` to `1`. Defaults to `1`.
properties.description: The light's specular component, from `0` to `1`. Defaults to `1`.

properties.name: smoothness
properties.brief: The light's attenuation, from `0` to `1`: `0` fills the radius evenly and `1` fades
properties.description:
The light's attenuation, from `0` to `1`: `0` fills the radius evenly and `1` fades
from the center to the edge. Defaults to `1`.
